items.text: Fixed Collector Of Sorrows being able to target itself.

Fixed an issue where undo could fail when using grafted equipment with Amplified Armaments.

releases.displayName: Monster Train 2’s second DLC, The Punished, OUT NOW with Major Patch!

items.text: TODAY IS THE DAY!!!
Monster Train 2’s second DLC, The Punished, is now available for $7.99! Players can now discover brand-new mechanics, unlock powerful Artifacts, and explore new synergies with The Punished clan.
Click the link below and dive into a run with The Punished today!
Want to see the new DLC in action and ask the developers your burning questions? Join the Shiny Shoe team for our official Launch Dev Stream today, November 10, 2026, at 2:00 PM PST!
Bring your questions and watch the stream here!
Patch Notes, Spoiler Warning, and a Thank You

Below you'll find the full patch notes which contains a complete list of all the balance changes and bug fixes we've made to Monster Train 2. After that, there are major spoilers for the DLC. Please only keep scrolling if you are interested in seeing that.

Finally, thank you all so much for supporting our team and for playing Monster Train and Monster Train 2! Without you, we could never get to do what we love so much: making games! So, again, thank you!
Now onto the Patch Notes and content for the DLC!
New content
Added The Punished clan DLC.
Updated the Soundtrack with all post-launch songs.
Increased Martyr’s Signet’s health gain from 6 to 8.
Fixed a typo in Skysong Trumpet’s Hymnist counter.
Fixed Magma Core’s description failing to update its Pyregel amount when enhanced by Hellfire Bellows.
Updated Heavenfall’s damage across all floors and the resulting death effects to resolve one floor at a time to smooth out camera movement.
Fixed Rally triggering one time too many the first time a Funguy stack is created on a floor.
Fixed an issue where Reanimate could cause units to overlap and become impossible to target when Funguy spawned.
Fixed Fertile Ground's card text not counting the base Spawn amount (no mechanical change, text fix only).
Fixed World-ending Strain artifact not always applying to enemies.
Fixed a softlock when a boss died while a Sentry Turret reaction was pending.
Added Pyre Blast to Pyre Steward, with a 3-turn cooldown, 3 damage to the Pyre, and damage equal to the Pyre’s attack to enemy units on its floor.
Fixed Molten Manifold’s effect doubling when copied by Spellchain.
Fixed the Forge Points display failing to appear after a Smelt card such as Foundry Line was added to a run without Railforged.
Fixed an issue where smelting merged equipment granted no Ember or Forge Points.
Fixed an undo failure after gaining and then losing a Forge card in a run where you are not playing the Railforged clan.
Fixed an undo failure in some situations when casting Fused Weaponry and canceling out of the second step.
Fixed a visual glitch on Full Throttle.
Fixed a typo in Trap Chute’s lore.
Fixed Spikedriver Spider’s art failing to load when Spikedriver Factory was used with Our Powers Combined.
Fixed Heph’s Metalworker path missing “Added Card” tooltip on the unit in battle at tiers 2 and 3.
Increased Horned Warrior’s attack from 15 to 20.
Fixed Shardtail Queen’s Imp Toss ability ignoring Spell Shield.
Added Piercing to Shardtail Queen’s Imp Toss ability.
Updated Restoration Detonation to count as a damage spell for interactions such as Conduit Tethys.
Reduced Guard of the Unnamed’s health from 25 to 20, added 20 starting Armor, and increased its Armor gain on Incant from 3 to 4.
Clarified Kinstone Totem’s description to specify that it triggers when a unit, spell, or artifact discarded a card before the end of the turn.
Fixed Ancient Synergy not counting consumed spells from your deck.
Reduced Formless Child’s Ember cost from 2 to 1.
Removed accidental undocumented Piercing from Exploding Candle.
Fixed Encased Ember not triggering when a Tomb unit dies with Reanimate.
Rector Flicker’s Dark Calling no longer puts cards into your draw pile when your hand is full and can no longer be activated with a full hand.
Fixed a harsh visual edge on Infused cards.
Echo Seedling no longer puts cards into your draw pile when your hand is full.
Heart of the Pact now works in the Deployment Phase.
Fixed an interaction between Crystallized Wing and Freezestone that caused a card to lose Permafrost when its Ember cost dropped below 3.
Fixed Crystallized Wing incorrectly freezing discounted Spellchain copies of cards that cost less than 3 Ember.
Fixed Sketches of Salvation summons failing to trigger Rally effects.
Fixed champion-specific and clan-specific event dialogue failing to appear in some languages.
Prevented Clipped Wings upgrades from being applied to Immobile units.
Fixed erroneous double application of Dusk Mantle granted via Red Crown when not playing Luna Coven on turns where it is New Moon.
Updated Dante’s Inferno’s damage and the resulting death effects to resolve one floor at a time to smooth out camera movement.
Fixed duplicate shop upgrades appearing after a reroll in some circumstances.
Fixed a typo in the Freezestone upgrade descriptions.
Fixed Holystone not able to be applied if you reduced a spell's base cost to zero.
Made bosses immune to Immobile and clarified the Relentless tooltip.
Fixed status-effect visual effects not displaying on Savagery and Dominion.

Fixed a softlock where the boss kill camera could play erroneously during your turn after a unit with Trample attacked, reported most frequently with Sentry Turret, but could also happen in other situations.
Fixed Room card visual effects persisting after the floor is destroyed by a boss.
Clarified the Fate Link tooltip’s status immunities and movement restrictions.
Fixed Frostpiercer and Plague Doctor applying no stacks to any enemy hit by a Sweep attack if the last enemy hit survived through Fate Link (such as Entropy at 1 HP).
Fixed a softlock that could occur when resuming a save after the game closed right as the Pyre is dying.
Fixed Ephemeral not triggering correctly when a card had temporary Consume added by Returned Soul or Gifts for a Guard.
Fixed Daily Challenges incorrectly appearing expired in certain languages and regions.
Fixed Musical Chairs triggering Shift multiple times on the same unit in certain situations.
Prevented run history from creating challenges that required DLC no longer installed.
Fixed an Echoes challenge starting node revealing the original clans before they were unlocked, which could lead to a broken run.
Fixed Light Forges failing to upgrade Mimic’s allied champion after your primary champion was purged.
Fixed Thaddeus the Indulgent's Thick Skinned ability having no description on higher difficulty tiers.
Fixed Keepstone’s Holdover effect failing after moving Goldie to another card.
Fixed merged Equipment descriptions sometimes omitting keywords.
Fixed Logbook enemy tracking for alternate enemy versions, including Titan Trial Fleshlings.
Fixed tooltips sometimes erroneously missing damage/stack numbers in the Logbook when using card search.
Fixed Titans victory crowns appearing for champions that had only defeated the Titans below Covenant 10 after the clan’s other champion won at Covenant 10.
Fixed room card mastery nameplates showing the default grey instead of matching mastery frames.
Fixed a rare error when opening Light Forge Upgrades in the Logbook while some clans were still locked.
Fixed incorrect card names and Ember costs appearing while cards were played or discarded.
Fixed Ascend/Descend spell previews on units failing to account for room card effects in the destination room in certain situations.
Fixed room upgrade icons showing the wrong floor after a boss freezes or corrupts a floor.
Fixed the P key failing to toggle character tooltips during battle.
Fixed cases where the post-combat Purge reward could not be exited or canceled.
Fixed various translation bugs.
Fixed the run summary, run history and challenge details screens failing to show dates with Arabic (Saudi Arabia) regional settings, and showing the wrong year with Thai regional settings.
Fixed an issue where some characters and backgrounds could fail to appear in Celestial Alcoves on systems using Turkish regional settings.
Fixed an error when closing the Mutators screen after abandoning a Dimensional Portal run from its opening card screen and starting a new run.
Added a DLC banner to the Covenant Outpost.
Improved app icon on the Mac version.

notes.title: The Punished's Class Mechanic: The Monolith

items.text: In Monster Train 2’s newest DLC, the Punished, this unique new clan comes with a new Class Mechanic called The Monolith.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45504256/d602b377cdea4d693d72e7b4247aa5e6d0e8c8fa.png"]
Much like Forge Points for the Railforged clan or the Dragon’s Hoard for the Pyreborne, the Monolith is a way for players to increase the attack power of Friendly Units throughout a run.
During Combat, players can offer ‘tributes’ to the Monolith by spending 1 EMBER and discarding a random card.
Each’ tribute’ increases a player’s level of DEVOTION (which does not diminish at the end of Combat). When a certain level of Devotion is reached, the Monolith Level increases.
With each increase of the Monolith’s level, so does the level of ZEAL with which a Friendly Unit enters the Combat. Some Punished cards receive interesting boosts as the Monolith levels increase.

Fixed a rare soft lock in Soul Savior when a specific situation combining Witherbloom and splitter units like Legion of Wax could interact in a problematic way.

Hi everyone, today we are launching a new update focused on QoL and bug fixes. There are a few balance changes as well.
Let us know if you have any feedback - we'll be watching and ready to respond if there are any new issues.

Added calculation of scaling value in the description for several artifacts. This includes artifacts like Historian’s Razor or Twisting Mycelium showing their impact in parentheses based on current gameplay state.
Added calculation of scaling values (e.g. health for number of cards in deck) in Celestial Alcove event reward descriptions.
Updated Freezestone to be able to be placed on cards with Permafrost.
Updated Holystone to heal based on the spell's base cost instead of modified cost except for X-cost cards.
Changed unit cloning (Assembly Room, Replicator Ray, etc.) to copy equipment.
Improved performance of scaling upgrades that can stack many times, like Pyre of Savagery or Bolete’s Hive Minder upgrade line.
Improved speed of Undo.
Reduced RAM consumption in a few areas.
Updated stat scaling in Overgrowth difficulty. Earlier battles should now be easier and scale up more gradually after each region.
In the first battle of Soul Savior, removed the enemies that were added in Tangle difficulty.
In the second battle of Soul Savior, regardless of region, removed one enemy on Tangle and Overgrowth difficulties.
Fixed Soul upgrades like Butterball Eaten trigger and Buffet stacks being transferred to units copied by Assembly Room or other similar effects.
Fixed Dutiful Sentinels battle in Soul Savior showing incorrect boss during preview.
Fixed Mother's Fleshfruit granting Titanskin instead of Burst.
Changed Grump's Strike trigger to Action. Increased the health gain on Grump III from 2 >> 3.
Reduced the health given by Showtime II and III from 35 >> 30.
Butterball II health given reduced from 25 >> 15. Butterball III health given reduced from 40 >> 25.
Meanmug base avarice reduced from 12 >> 9. Avarice given by Celebrate reduced from 5 >> 4.
Fixed upgraded armor from Slacy not showing up on grafted equipment tooltip.
Fixed Soul attachment card selection UI sometimes showing too soon when Quick Restarting a run.
Fixed Soul equipped cards put in a Jack-in-the-Box or Small-Gift-Box retaining Soul upgrades if those Souls are moved to other cards later.
Fixed bug where a card with Bougie that was duplicated in battle would sometimes have Attuned applied to magic power granted through non-Bougie effects.
Blacksmith Herzal stats increased from (20/30/40 atk, 10/12/15 health) >>> (30/40/50 atk, 15/20/25 health).
Fixed intermittent Undo failure for Fused Weaponry.
Fixed Magnetic Relay from units with Enchant not causing Enchant effects to be removed from floor.
Fixed Juggernaut's Summon trigger not being affected by silence.
Updated Pyre Plating to not move the camera to the Pyre. It was causing issues with other interactions such as with Spell Sanctum.
Converted Steelguard from a trait into a status effect under the hood so that it can be transferred by Superfood Primordium and removed by Eel Gorgon.
Fixed Anvil Breaker damaging front friendly unit if no enemies in room.
Fixed Herzal's Hammer granting extra armor to units with Dualism, even if the unit applying armor does not have Dualism.
Fixed Craft tooltip incorrectly saying it shows 3 options instead of 2 options.
Changed wording on a few Railforged pieces of content that should have said apply instead of grant.
Fixed Magnetic Relay when recast by Abyssal Prism incorrectly returning Champion units to the player's hand.
Added Logbook tracking for Boilerplate permanent armor gain.
Fixed Egg hatch previews only working the first time you trigger it, then failing to preview upon additional cards being played/additional card play hovers.
Fixed Echo Vault not granting Charged Echoes when triggering with Infused cards.
Fixed Wurmkin unit banners on the map always offering rare units with Shattered Halo.
Fixed several unit cards not gaining Infused in drafts.
Fixed Glugsider ability Eat not triggering Slay.
Fixed Eagleheart not causing immobile units to attack immediately if they are in the back of the room.
Fixed Fel's Valiant III multistrike preview only working the first time you trigger it, then failing to preview upon additional cards being played/additional card play hovers.
Fixed Fae's Nook Conduit persisting after death.
Fixed Evolutionary Instinct causing softlock with Lifemother debuff transfer variant.
Fixed units with Grafted equipment having duplicate equipment when spawning into a room with Hall of Mirrors.
Fixed an issue where Abyssal Prism + Weaponized Prosthetic did not apply the attack bonus to the non-primary target if other units on the same floor also had equipment removed.
Fixed Adaptive Mutation not properly healing units with Old Growth in some circumstances.
Added Sting tooltip to Channelheart and Thorncasing artifacts.
Changed food units to not be eaten if silenced or muted.
Fixed Resin Blades not returning to hand when grafted.
Fixed Resin Blades not returning to hand when a unit with Hatch dies or hatches.
Fixed Rector Flicker character VFX not being visible in battle.
Fixed instances of Misshapen Fiend's extinguish trigger still occurring when Muted.
Ensured certain Soul Savior mutators aren’t available for Daily Challenges.
Fixed Fancy Footwork attack granted not persisting after death.
Changed Abyssal Prism to only work with cards that directly target a unit.
Fixed bug with navigation (keyboard/controller) where you could use a room ability when not looking at the room you are activating it from.
Fixed Historian's Razor event softlock occurring when you remove an artifact with only the Wurmkin starter artifact and a Boss artifact.
Fixed Echo Vault attempting to preview random effect cards, which shows wrong information and is misleading.
Fixed Wurmkin and Railforged drafts not working with Banner-ed, Our Powers Combined mutators, and Pact of the First Armageddon artifact.
Fixed Banner-ed mutator causing Melting Remnant banner drafts to give Pyreborne cards.
Added MT2 clans and Wurmkin to A New Challenger mutator card pool.
Fixed regression in Dominating Authority event card upgrade that allowed it to pick cards from hand. Now it should be back to how it worked pre-Railforged DLC release.
Fixed Uncoordinated mutator lowering the Pyre's attack.
Fixed Savage Heart having two Rage tooltips.
Fixed Train Room ability icon appearing in preview on hover when it should not.
Removed Echo Bloom from It's Free Real Estate mutator card pool.
Removed Forgotten Trade and Ambient Charge from Truffles card pool and Enchanted Armory mutator card pool.
Fixed Dominating Authority making an undiscardable unit card, if it picked a unit from the discard pile.
Fixed various text issues in multiple languages.
We hope you are enjoying the Wurmkin and the Destiny of the Railforged DLC! We have been carefully watching feedback and have added a few new features on top of additional bug fixes in this update.
Soul Savior Win Streak Tracking - one streak for each of the difficulties.
Soul Savior Stat Tracking - a separate section in the Logbook for your best stats specifically in Soul Savior mode.
Soul randomization updated to work like clan randomization. You cannot see the randomized Souls until the run begins and the decision to choose random Souls is persisted across runs.

Added ability to detach souls directly from the Soul list in the HUD. Also, Soul attaching and detaching should now be allowed in most areas excluding in battle. It wasn't previously possible in the merchant screen, for example.
The number of allowed Soul draft rerolls are now limited per-run rather than per-draft.
Changed Soul Savior upgraded Merchants to no longer apply a discount to the Purge and Reroll options for consistency and improved communication.

Fixed Showtime triggering the unit stat boost in the Deployment Phase. It now only happens at the end of combat outside of the Deployment Phase. This makes Showtime consistent with other similar effects.
Fixed incorrect Gorgon soul bonus stat scaling when equipped on Hammerfall.
Fixed a bug where rapid inputs in certain UI situations could result in Soul duplication.
Fixed Mimic soul sometimes being offered as a draft reward when it should be excluded.
Fixed inconsistent Stackstone/Entropic Stone Merchant filtering for cards with the Mollis Soul present.
Soul upgrades on cards will no longer cause normal Merchant upgrades to be excluded.
Souls presented for draft rewards will be skipped on the next re-roll, if enough unlocked Souls are available to make that possible.
Fixed bug in where upgrading a Champion for the 4th time after fully upgrading one path would only provide one option.
Fixed Slacy spelling when applied to card.
Fixed Metamind soul showing doubled bonus text.
Athane the Fallen in Soul Savior now Incants rage instead of infested. She also Retreats on Strike.
Fixed Lifemother stat values not scaling with the Difficulty setting in the battle intro screen.
Fixed Soul Savior negative mutator Sadist applying additional Witherbloom when Troop stacks are added.
Fixed Herzal permaforge upgrade line tiers 2 and 3 not persisting attack increases correctly across battles.
Fixed Heph's Weaponsmith buffs being applied to enemies when equipping them.
Changed Burst to only decrement after all attacks from Multistrike have occurred.
Car Collapse cost reduced from 2 >>> 0. Added Consume.
Magnetic Relay updated from "Return a friendly unit..." >>> "Return a non-champion friendly unit..."
Fixed Magnetic Relay not returning grafted equipment on units that are not the original grafted unit.
Pyre Steward updated. Removed ability 'Pyre Repair'. Now has "Slay: Restore 2 Pyre Health." Stats updated from 10 atk/30 health >>> 30 atk/10 health.
Made Forge buffs apply when playing Penitent's Bloodsuit or Penitent's Deathsuit on player's units.
Fixed Herzal's Blacksmith champ path incorrectly rendering green text when viewed from the Logbook.
Fixed Herzal's Hammer accidentally showing Titanskin tooltip.
Boilerplate removed from Red Crown event pool and Grafted Equipment event pool, due to it not synergizing with other clans that might draft it.
Added missing Forge and Smelt tooltips to some Railforged artifacts.
Fixed Heph's hand overlapping on Hammer handle.
Updated Fleshweaver enemy compositions for each variant. The more difficult versions should be slightly easier now.
Dazed, Suppressed and Inert status effects no longer block "Attack Immediately" effects.
Fixed various visual issues with the unit limit indicator that appears when a room has 7 units.
Fixed awkward camera motion when a boss is killed while entering Relentless by the Sentry Turret.
Fixed bug where it was possible to play cards immediately after an Undo before some artifacts could trigger, which could break Undo.
Fixed Endless restoring grafted equipment to revived unit card.
Fixed Abyssal Prism not granting card draw bonuses for Beelziebub soul correctly.
Fixed bug where Pyreborne's Insignia would be impacted by Dualism.

Fixed Dusk Mantle granting extra Titanskin when unit is silenced or muted. This should also fix anything else that instantly grants an upgrade related to Full Moon or New Moon triggers while interacting with silenced/muted.
Fixed characters with Vanguard not losing their bonuses if Silenced or Muted when at front of room.
Fixed Wurmkin map banner position.
Improved text consistency in error message when trying to play unit or room in Pyre room.
Scrivener ability Spellweave updated to only target non-starter cards.
Rootseeds atk increased from 2 >>> 3.
Removed mention of test mechanic 'Dormant' in Fuel tooltip.
Fixed 'Forgone Power' incorrectly attempting to discard Persistent cards such as 'Scrap Metal'.
Fixed Pyre Heart dialog title in Run Setup screen not properly updating.
Fixed slowdown when using Boilerplate equipment with a lot of Forge Points.
Fixed an undo failure related to rapidly ending your turn before all of a played card's triggers fire, most commonly seen with Wurmkin.
Fixed Smelt effects sometimes softlocking card selection when recast by Echo Vault and playing with a controller or keyboard.
Updated Mollis Soul to no longer be attachable to cards unless they directly apply Status Effects.
Fixed a few typos.

Hi everyone, we are continuing to work on fixing various issues and are preparing a few small new features for the Railforged DLC for future release. In the meantime, today we are releasing the following set of improvements:
Fixed an undo failure that was possible when using a combination of rooms with abilities and the Manifold Mirror artifact.
Fixed Heph's Weaponsmith buffs being applied to enemies when equipping them.
Fixed Geared Gauntlet preventing Sentry Turret from attacking.
Fixed Red Crown, Truffles Fetch ability, and Plague Doctor event incorrectly handing out broken Railforged-only equipment when the DLC is not installed.
Fixed Improved Deployable upgrade in Soul Savior reducing ember cost of cards by more than it should.
Controller/Keyboard - added hotkey for toggling Forge Points (default is right stick click on controllers, H on keyboard).
Improved clarity of Herzal's Enduring Steel upgrade line in English.
Fixed a typo that said "friendy." Thanks Rhapsody for being a friendy.
Fixed uncommon hang while killing Infested units with other Room effects present.
Fixed Wurmkin eggs potentially hatching multiple times when silence is removed.
Fixed Railforged Spike unintentionally showing Burst tooltip.
Fixed an issue where Wurmkin progress would not animate correctly in the Logbook if the DLC was not owned.
Updated Burst wording for clarity. "Attacks an additional time. Remove 1 stack on Strike." >>> "Attacks an additional time per stack. Remove 1 stack after each attack made this way."
Updated Multistrike wording for consistency. "Attacks an additional time each turn." >>> "Attacks an additional time per stack."
Improved mousewheel scrolling in Soul Progression UI.

Thank you to everyone who has been playing our latest update and Destiny of the Railforged. We are committed to fixing all major bugs. Today, we are starting with resolving a few priority and small issues, but will be releasing more updates in the coming days.
Fixed bug where sometimes a Soul Savior run could not be fully generated and would leave some sections empty.
Fixed unlocalized button on region select screen.
Fixed Boilerplate and Geared Gauntlet being missing from some card pools, like Swordmaiden's.
Fixed Juggernaut text showing +20/+20 instead of +30/+30.
Fixed Forged UI not activating when a unit with a Forge effect is added from an Event or Mutator.
Prevented Railforged DLC upgrades from being applied by Malicka's Shifting Pyre.
Fixed issue on some Macs with older operating systems where a native library would fail to load and make the game unplayable.
Fixed issue where Railforged Logbook progress page could initialize improperly in some situations if the DLC is not installed.
Fixed text wrapping looking ugly in some languages in some new UI labels.
This update focuses on fixing bugs with the recent Echoes from the Void release. Here is the full list of changes:
Fixed Influential mutator not loading character art correctly.
Fixed card art not loaded when you obtain characters like Lunar Priestess when not playing Luna Coven who then creates a Moon Ritual card.
Fixed card and character art not loaded with Our Powers Combined mutator in some cases.
Fixed the first tier of Bolete Executioner's path missing text that described the Troop benefit.

Fixed an issue where the Titan Trial "More Mass" variant of Fleshweaver had fewer stacks of Mass then intended. All Trial versions gain an additional 4 stacks of Mass, which is now correctly added to the additional 3 stacks that this variant gains, putting it at 12 stacks of Mass with the Trial enabled.
Changed Fleshweaver's "Mass" status so that it is no longer removable via effects that remove Buffs.
Fixed bug where killing Stryx or Hallow would sometimes give the other boss double status effects.
Fixed bug where you could not Ascend Stryx or Hallow after the other is defeated.
Fixed Crystallized Wing only working with Spell type cards. It now works with all card types.
Made it so new Logbook statistic victory tracking doesn't count if the run had mutators enabled.
Fixed unit abilities not going into cooldown when the unit has Purified Essence upgrade.
Fixed Purified Essence not being properly applied when a unit card with Purified Essence is duplicated.
Added new Dimensional Challenges to the number of challenges to complete in the Logbook progress page.
Reduced the Covenant Rank on "Moving Madness" dimensional challenge from 3 >> 1.
Fixed various champion stat tracking issues where gains to certain stats should only be tracked if they come from the champion's upgrades.
Hi everyone, today we have another small update to fix a few bugs.
Fixed Mix spells breaking Undo feature when recast by Echo Vault.
Fixed Echo Vault incorrectly resetting selected hand card after casting a spell.
Fixed an issue with Dominating Authority unit upgrade incorrectly over-triggering when equipped on multiple units
Fixed exploit where merging Organ Harvester and Resin Blades would allow the new equipment to be placed on enemies, instantly killing bosses.
Today's patch is another small bug fix follow up to the Lost Arsenal update. It also includes a few balance changes. Thank you to everyone who has reported issues.

items.text: Fixed an undo issue affecting certain spells recast by Echo Vault.
Fixed Echo Vault previewing a Boss deathblow incorrectly disabling further hand card interaction.
Fixed Echo Vault incorrectly applying Freezestone bonus on recast spells.
Fixed Smelted Treasure spell with upgrades incorrectly requiring more than 50 gold.
Fixed Jackstrips dealing 2 damage instead of 3 damage when descending units.
Fixed bug where units in Stasis would not have their Rally effects triggered when a Troop unit is spawned.
Fixed bug where Mageblade would not incorporate the magic power of units in Stasis.
Ekka Celestial Spellweaver stats increased from 15/8, 25/8, 35/8 >>> 25/12, 30/12, 35/12.

Fixed Awakening Thicket, Engine Upgrade, and Crucible Extension being missing from certain card pools.
Restoring Retreat's Ember cost reduced back down from 2 >>> 1. Healing reduced back down from 25 >>> 10.
Titanchannel Solgard tier I & II stat gain from Resurgence increased from 6/6, 10/10 >>> 8/8, 12/12.
Prevented Manifold Mirror artifact from incorrectly duping 'Siren's Song' room card to all floors.

This is a minor update focused on bug fixes for Lost Arsenal. We hope you are enjoying the new content! We are still working on a few other issues, including an Undo issue related to Echo Vault, but wanted to get this update out before the weekend.

notes.title: Here is the full list of changes

items.text: Fixed an issue with Echo Vault incorrectly recasting X Cost spells with zero ember.
Disallowed Infusion spells being recast by Echo Vault. Infusion cards are not meant to be copy-able for any reason.
Fixed bug where text on Fel's Unchained path would sometimes be incorrect.
Fixed bug where Fel's Unchained upgrade line would give extra Valor on Shift.

Updated Attuned Manacles to only trigger a maximum of once per turn. Cooldown reduction increased from 1 >>> 2. Now reduces cooldowns of all friendly units on all floors. This was done to fix an easy to obtain infinite interaction.
Fixed Titan Trial Default setting causing Titan Trials to be enabled even if the run type doesn't support Titan Trials.
Fixed Smelted Treasure still granting armor even with no gold.
Fixed a few room and equipment cards not appearing in proper card pools for shops and units.
Fixed bug where Consumer of Crowns's ability could target other floors and cause game breaking issues.
Fixed Vinemother trigger procing during deployment phase.
Changed Siren Song to use its previous singing sound effect.
Fixed interaction between Animus of Speed and Iron Tongue where Animus of Speed's ability would not correctly Sweep.
Fixed an issue with Echo Vault targeting when recasting Tiresome Climb spell into an empty unit position.

releases.displayName: Lost Arsenal Free Content Update Out Now!

items.text: Lost Arsenal is now live! Monster Train 2’s first free update offers plenty of new opportunities to hone your strategy and approach each run in new and exciting ways! In this update, you’ll find…
New Cards for Every Clan

Every Monster Train 2 clan now has unique, powerful new cards to add to your arsenal and transform your run strategy. Whether you’re looking to scale your damage with Glutton’s Maw or reach new magical potential with Echo Vault, these new cards will open up a world of possibilities.

notes.title: New Clanless Equipment and Room Cards

items.text: Strategize with a range of new room and equipment cards that bring additional layers of depth to your runs. Give the start of your turn an edge with cards such as Weapons Cache, which draws Equipment Cards and reduces its cost each time you spawn a new allied unit. This is just one of the many new cards to explore. See the full list with screenshots below!

notes.title: A Newly Balanced and Tuned Game

items.text: Want the full breakdown of everything that’s been added and changed? You can now view the complete balance notes for Lost Arsenal in a two part series on Steam. The first part, which details major reworks to existing cards, and the second offers a complete list of balance changes made to Monster Train 2. The list below details every balance change and bug fix in one place for your convenience.

Lost Arsenal brings a fresh wave of strategic depth to Monster Train 2, so pick your champion, optimize your deck and prepare for the ultimate run! We can’t wait to see how you adapt your strategies to the latest additions in Lost Arsenal and what new synergies you’ll discover. Let us know your thoughts on the update either in the comments or in the Shiny Shoe Discord server and be sure to share your most creative builds for everyone to enjoy! Want more Monster Train 2 content? Subscribe to the Shiny Shoe newsletter for behind-the-scenes tidbits! And, finally, don't forget to join us for a special dev stream on Twitch at 12:00 PM PDT today, September 10th!

notes.title: Other New Features & Quality of Life

items.text: Added "Titan Trial Default" option to gameplay settings to optionally automatically enable all Titan Trials. Added a tutorial to explain this.

Updated flavor text order in TitanEntropy event to match the order of the choices.

Fixed 'Emot Tome' incorrectly copying cost bonus from 'Ancient Roots' onto its Ephemeral duplicate card.

Draff ATK increased from 10 >>> 15.

Hi everyone, today we have launched an update to Monster Train 2 with a variety of bug fixes, balance changes, UI fixes/features, and translation improvements. Check out the list below for full details.
Thank you for playing Monster Train 2! We've got more updates to come as we work to make MT2 the best game it can be.
We are going to start numbering the patches from now on. This is patch 1.1.2.
Fixed a softlock when the ‘Twisting Mycelium’ artifact is present under rare circumstances.
Fixed a softlock caused by combinations of Reanimate, Burnout, and Harvest under certain conditions.
Fixed a Cluster Colonel spawned Funguy making the front friendly character unplayable under rare conditions.

Fixed visual issues with TFB background.
Fixed a sorting issue with Chosen VFX.
Fixed Astreal the Lost having incorrect Titan affinity VFX.
Fixed Mooncaller feet, reanimate visuals, and relentless debris not being clipped by the floor properly.
Fixed Savage Spirit upgrade not granting the correct amount of attack.
Fixed bug where restarting a battle in the middle of playing Soldier of Fortune or similar unit-drawing cards could leave a card stuck on-screen.
Fixed Trample damage not triggering Avarice.
Fixed bug where Sacrificial Chamber would not trigger for bosses.

Fixed bug where Canio, Yorrick, Kwilling Catcher, and Avarice were not impacted by the Tithe or Moneybag mutators.
Fixed Corruption status effect being unaffected by Propagate effects.

Fixed the 'Split Anvil' artifact incorrectly leaving a cost bonus on spell copies sent directly to the discard pile (ex: Spreading Spores, Contagious).

Today we are releasing our third bug fix and tuning update for Monster Train 2 after launch. We didn't make Steam posts for the prior updates so I will merge all notes from all patches into this post. In the future, we will do a post each time.
We are working on more bug fixes, quality of life improvements, and non-English translation improvements. Those will be releasing soon.
